what_it_does: Presents AERIS, a new Earth weather prediction system that uses a large transformer-based neural network (between 1.3 and 80 billion parameters) trained to forecast weather at pixel-level resolution. Traditional deterministic weather models have systematic biases and produce poorly-calibrated ensemble predictions. The transformer architecture allows AERIS to capture long-range weather patterns and uncertainties. The model introduces a new parallelization technique called SWiPe that trains efficiently across multiple processors without needing extra communication.
